title: 第189章奇怪的石头第188章大罗金仙
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
第189章奇怪的石头
“如今这块地已经是我的了，那么它的安全性就比其他的地方要更高一些，以后我们就会将这里作为真正的基地。”
总算是不用再继续建造自己的地下宫殿了。
打造仙界的第一步，专心将这红色的区域先优打造完成。
因为这里最安全，不会有其他的仙兽之类的来干扰到他们。
但这大片的岩浆却成了一个很大的问题。
郁凡仔细的思考了一番，决定在离岩浆远稍微远一点的地方去打造。
可别让自己的房子没有打造出来，就先一步被那岩浆直接给灼烧了。
况且离岩浆越近的地方温度也越高，就算自己是现在这里的主人也无法控制这岩浆的温度，该烫的还是烫。
想到自己在接近岩浆之前便被烫出了不少的水泡，他有些心有余悸，那岩浆灼烧的痛苦简直是太难忍受了。
从仙界布局图上便能看出他之前渡劫的东方地区再过去一点，实际上是有一条矿脉的。
而那矿脉正是仙石矿。
郁凡可没有想过要用普通的石头去搭建自己的基地，当然就做搭建最好的准备，既然已经知道了所有的材料。
那么好的资源送到自己的手上不用才是傻瓜吧。
带着白澈便直接前往那块地域而去。
不一会儿便到达了之前所渡劫的地方。
在那旁边，确实是存在着一条山脉。
郁凡眼睛一亮，虽然没有从那山脉上感觉到那里有什么特殊的仙气波动。
但地布局图上已经显示了这里便是仙石矿。
郁凡朝着山脉飞去。

白澈好奇地说道：“这似乎就是一个普通的山脉呀，已经存在很多年了，似乎在我小的时候，他就在这儿了。”
“可我们从来没有发现他是你所说的那个什么仙脉。”
郁凡暗暗想着，要是让你们所有的仙兽都知道了，这里是仙石矿，那还有我的什么事，自然是隐藏的比较特别了。
他之前渡劫的时候也曾看到过这条山脉，那时候也并没有想到这会是一条仙石矿。
直到站在那山脉上郁凡也没有感受到这个山脉到底是哪里存在着仙石。
他轻轻的叹了一口气，想来这又需要大量的功夫去寻找了。
或者有什么可以感应到仙石存在的东西，那便好找很多了。
郁凡眼睛一亮，对了，他手上的云螭剑。
剑灵比人类及仙兽对于有灵气之物的感应要更加的强烈一些，毕竟他们原本就是由这些灵石所打造出来的。
就是不知道，作为仙品低阶的云螭剑，是否能有这么强大的感应能力？
但总得试试吧，否则这么大一座山，找起来也需要花费很多的时间，说不定云螭剑就刚好能够解决这个难题呢。
郁凡祭出云螭剑，并将自己的诉求告知了云螭剑，它不断的晃动着自己的身躯，似乎有些抗议，只能拿它做苦工。
震动了好一会儿，也没有见到郁凡来安慰自己，云螭剑有些垂头丧气地飞了起来，直朝着山脉中心而去。
在云螭剑看来，这片天地全都布满了仙气，他压根就没有察觉到哪里有不对劲的。

content_en:
Chapter 189 Strange Stone
"Now that this land is mine, its security is higher than other places. We will use this as our real base in the future."
Finally, I no longer have to continue building my own underground palace.
The first step in creating a fairyland is to focus on building this red area first.
Because this is the safest place, there will be no other fairy beasts to interfere with them.
But this large area of ​​magma has become a big problem.
Yu Fan thought carefully and decided to build it a little further away from the magma.
Don't let your house be burned directly by the magma before it is built.
Moreover, the closer to the magma, the higher the temperature. Even if you are the current owner here, you cannot control the temperature of the magma. It should be hot.
He was a little frightened when he thought that he had suffered a lot of blisters before he got close to the magma. The pain of the burning magma was simply too unbearable.
From the layout map of the fairy world, it can be seen that there is actually a mineral vein a little further away in the eastern region where he had passed the tribulation before.
And that vein is the fairy stone mine.
Yu Fan had never thought about using ordinary stones to build his base. Of course, he made the best preparations for the construction since he already knew all the materials.
You would be a fool if you don't use such good resources.
He took Bai Che and headed directly to that area.
After a while, they arrived at the place where they had overcome the tribulation before.
Next to that, there is indeed a mountain range.
Yu Fan's eyes lit up, although he didn't feel any special fairy energy fluctuations from the mountain range.
But the land layout map has shown that this is the fairy stone mine.
Yu Fan flew towards the mountains.
Bai Che said curiously: "This seems to be an ordinary mountain range. It has existed for many years. It seems that it was here when I was young."
"But we never found out that he was the Immortal Vein you mentioned."
Yu Fan secretly thought, if all of you immortal beasts knew that this was an immortal stone mine, then what else would happen to me, it would naturally be more special to hide it.
He had seen this mountain range before during his tribulation, and at that time he had not thought that this would be a fairy stone mine.
Until he stood on the mountain range, Yu Fan didn't feel where the immortal stone existed in the mountain range.
He sighed softly, thinking that it would take a lot of effort to find it.
Or if there is something that can sense the existence of fairy stones, it would be much easier to find.
Yu Fan's eyes lit up, and by the way, there was the Yun Chi Sword in his hand.
Sword spirits have a stronger sense of spiritual things than humans and fairy beasts. After all, they were originally created from these spiritual stones.
I just don’t know whether the Yun Chi Sword, which is a low-level immortal, can have such a powerful sensing ability?
But you have to give it a try, otherwise it will take a lot of time to find such a big mountain. Maybe Yun Chi Sword can just solve this problem.
Yu Fan sacrificed Yun Chi Sword and told Yun Chi Sword of his demands. It kept shaking its body, as if in protest, and could only use it to do hard work.
After being shaken for a while and not seeing Yu Fan coming to comfort him, Yun Chijian flew up with some dejection and headed straight towards the center of the mountain range.
From Yun Zhijian's point of view, the whole world was filled with immortal energy, and he didn't notice anything was wrong at all.
